bio.text: Edgardo Baez is the Republican nominee in Texas's 20th Congressional District, according to the San Antonio Report, which describes Baez as a U.S. Army veteran, retired medical professional, lawyer and published author.

In a candidate questionnaire for the San Antonio Report, Baez said San Antonio is home, and listed past service as an Army combat medic, airborne paratrooper and drill sergeant, past work as an intensive care unit nurse, and 20 years as an attorney in San Antonio.
